segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on; Case Blackwell opens with chat greetings and wrestling talk.

segments.title: Hulk Hogan Booed at WWE Netflix Debut
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple react to viral footage of Hulk Hogan being booed at the WWE Netflix premiere; discussion of Real American Beer and Rick Derringer.

segments.title: Israel-Gaza Ceasefire Announcement
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover the Biden administration's ceasefire deal announcement, three-phase structure, Trump's credit-claiming, and Biden's press conference exit.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers
segments.notes: Field correspondent Trent (with parole officer Chris) reviews trailers for Witcher anime, Daredevil: Born Again, Apple Cider Vinegar, The Night Agent S2, and Woman in the Yard.

segments.title: TikTok Ban Imminent; Red Note Migration
segments.notes: Case and Tyler discuss the Supreme Court's likely upholding of the TikTok ban, potential sale to Elon Musk, 90-day extension provisions, and the exodus to Chinese app Red Note (Xiaohongshu).

segments.title: Amongst the Web with Leon Kennedy
segments.notes: Leon Kennedy hosts viewer-submitted video rankings: moonwalker, hatchet-to-face training, snowman lookalike, Marjorie Taylor Greene fan video, sushi order dispute, prison guard sex scandal, whipping video, and butter-bath dog hack.

segments.title: DJ Newsic Musical Finale
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs raw, unfiltered autotune-free set; Case browses hot tub prices and discusses housing legal status, patio gym, and upcoming schedule.

segments.title: Drake Defamation Lawsuit vs. UMG; Little Tommy Big Law
segments.notes: Case covers Drake's defamation suit over 'Not Like Us'; Little Tommy Big Law delivers surreal legal opinion involving nipple jurisprudence.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Israel-Gaza ceasefire deal announcement with skeptical analysis of Biden's victory lap and Trump's credit-claiming, then pivoted to the imminent TikTok ban and the ironic migration to Chinese app Red Note. The broadcast featured a movie trailer review segment with Trent, a chaotic Amongst the Web hosted by Leon Kennedy, a raw DJ Newsic set during which Case revealed housing legal limbo and a new MWF schedule, and closed with Drake's defamation lawsuit against UMG adjudicated by Little Tommy Big Law's nipple-centric jurisprudence.
